bridge_candidate_policy.interpretation: Eligibility only removes registered theorem-root endpoints from the bridge-candidate subset. It does not rank or certify mathematical importance.

firewalls: atom membership is exact dependency-set membership, not logical classification
cross-atom edge is compiler usage, not semantic implication
bridge frontier is discovery-only and does not establish a missing theorem
module or namespace concentration does not establish mathematical importance
registered RH-equivalent roots are excluded from bridge-candidate endpoints
